titulo_it: Se avessi soldi, comprerei una casa
titulo_es: The ipothetic period of type II: the unreal

texto: **Prótasis (la condición)**: always with **se + congiuntivo imperfetto** (**Se avessi soldi**, **Se potessi scegliere**).
**Apódosis (la consecuencia)**: in **condizionale presente** (**comprerei una casa**, **andrei al mare**). Never use the parole behind * se *!

bloques.titulo: The «Se fossi in te» advice formula
texto: It exactly equals «If I were you» or «If I were you». It is the most idiomatic way to recommend a behavior: **Se fossi in te, chiederei una vacanza**.

filas: I don't have enough money now.
I advise you to take a vacation.

frases.it: Se avessi soldi, comprerei una casa.
frases.es: Si tuviera dinero, compraría una casa.
frases.en: If I had money, I'd buy a house.

frases.it: Se fossi in te, chiederei una vacanza.
frases.es: Si yo fuera tú, pediría unas vacaciones.
frases.en: If I were you, I'd ask for a vacation.
I wish! I'd live on the beach.

opciones.texto: Se avessi soldi.
opciones.explicacion: «Se» + congiuntive imfect of the verb «avere».

opciones.texto: Se ho soldi.
opciones.explicacion: This is an indicative type I (actual condition).

opciones.texto: Se avrei soldi.
opciones.explicacion: Serious error: The conditional is never introduced with «se».

opciones.explicacion: The usual formula for giving empathic advice on parole.

bloques.frase: Lavorerei meno se avessi più tempo per me.

opciones.texto: I'd work less if I had more personal time.
opciones.explicacion: Conditional («lavorerei») and congiuntive prosecstasy («se avessi»).

opciones.texto: I work less because I got fired from the company.
opciones.explicacion: It's an unreal hypothesis, not a narrative of events that happened.

opciones.texto: I don't want to work any more in my life.
opciones.explicacion: It plans a desired reduction of the day.

opciones.texto: An ideal longing or lifestyle that contrasts with the current situation.
opciones.explicacion: «vivere»'s simple conditional to project a personal desire.

opciones.texto: That the speaker already resides in a coastal town since he was a child.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses an unconcrete hypothetical preference.

opciones.texto: He hates the sea and prefers the big industrial cities.
opciones.explicacion: It's an enthusiastic taste to the coast.

bloques.frase: Se fossi in te chiederei una vacanza al direttore
bloques.traduccion: If I were you, I'd ask the director for a vacation.
bloques.explicacion: Advice with «se fossi in te» and courtesy conditional.

opciones.explicacion: Congiuntive imperfect after «se» and conditional on aprodose.

intro: The type II hypothetical period is about unlikely, imaginative or contrary situations to the present reality: «If I had money, I'd buy a house.».
